def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row)
    background = max((value for value in counts if value != 0), key=counts.get)
    marker = next(value for value in counts if value not in (0, background))
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(height) for c in range(width) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    top = min(r for r, c in points)
    left = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r - top, c - left) for r, c in points]
    shape_h = max(r for r, c in shape) + 1
    shape_w = max(c for r, c in shape) + 1

    output = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(height - shape_h + 1):
        for c in range(width - shape_w + 1):
            if all(grid[r + dr][c + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in shape):
                for dr, dc in shape:

    return output
'''
